title: vLLM KV-cache preemptions
description: Engine requests evicted from KV cache and recomputed per bucket. Nonzero values identify work lost to cache pressure; compare occupancy and queue growth. Zero means no preemption was recorded. Engine telemetry supplies these observations. Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

defaults.noValue: No vLLM rows for this run. If the whole rank is blank, the engine exporter is down rather than six separate faults.
